_readme: The shape of a reel made from a sesh-edit episode (#55). Copy it next to the episode's outputs (never into the repo: a real one quotes the interview), fill in the paths and spans, then: bun run reel <that file>. Spans are clean-cut seconds; find them with bun scripts/reel/find-words.ts <decisions> "quoted words". Crops: bun scripts/reel/stills.ts <that file>.
title: Guest - the best 30 seconds
